newsitem.title: USA: Learning Tree files for 2.0 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Learning Tree files for 2.0 mln shr offer.

text.p: Learning Tree International Inc said Tuesday it has registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 2.0 million shares of common stock.

Of the shares being offered, 1.6 million are by selling stockholders and 400,000 by the company. Selling stockholders have granted the underwriters an option to buy up to an additional 300,000 shares to cover over-allotments, if any.
The offering is being managed by an underwriting group led by Robertson, Stephens & Co LLC, Piper Jaffray Inc, Smith Barney Inc and M Kane & Co Inc.
